title: S060 7.6.1 Allow Short Sequence Numbers Feature
parent_path: S060 7.6.1 Allow Short Sequence Numbers Feature

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: When Allow Short Seqnos/B is zero, DCCP B MUST NOT send packets with short sequence numbers and DCCP A MUST ignore any packets with short sequence numbers that are received.
actions: do not send packets with short sequence numbers
